names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 mai, «Sfântul Iosif de la Optina».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Ιωσήφ της Όπτινα», with the rank word left off. No Russian form is recorded: saint.gr prints his worldly name only in Greek letters, «Ιβάν Ευθύμοβιτς Λιτόφκιν», and a Cyrillic form would be a transliteration.

The heading of the calendar’s name page 6990, «Иосиф Оптинский, прп.», with the rank abbreviation left off. The life page heads him more fully still, «Преподобный Иосиф (Литовкин), старец Оптиной пустыни», so the calendar gives both the place-epithet and the surname Литовкин; the form stored is the one the name link itself carries. The day’s own line declines him «Прп. Иосифа Оптинского (1911)». `fk.mjs` returned NONE before the write.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 мая ст. ст. — «Прп. Иосифа Оптинского (1911).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact: the calendar’s life heads him «Преподобный Иосиф (Литовкин), старец Оптиной пустыни», born Иван Литовкин on 2 November 1837 to the village elder Ефим Литовкин, cell-attendant and then successor of the elder Амвросий, skete superior and confessor of the Optina brotherhood and of the Shamordino sisters, dead 1911 — the same man and the same two years the folder already held from saint.gr. `dates` is unchanged; the Russian life gives the day as well as the year, «тихо отошел ко Господу 9/22 мая 1911 года», which is the day the calendar keeps him on in both styles, and the burial on 12 мая. His name page lists one other day, «11 октября (Оптин.)», the synaxis of the Optina elders; one row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it. The day page prints no troparion and no kontakion under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 mai — «Sfântul Iosif de la Optina»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Ιωσήφ της Όπτινα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the head line «(1837 - 1911)» fixes him as the elder of Optina and not one of the name sweep's many Josephs. **`dates` are added where the folder had none**: the page gives the day of his birth, «γεννήθηκε στις 2 Νοεμβρίου 1837», and the year of his repose, 1911, and no day for the latter. **The Greek adds what the folder lacked**: his name in the world, Ivan Evfimovich Litovkin; his village Gorodishche in the district of Starobelsk in the province of Kharkov; his parents Euthymius Emilianovich and Maria Vasilievna and all six of their children; the sister Alexandra who became the nun Leonida and told of his childhood; the loss of both parents to cholera when he was four; the tonsures of 15 April and 16 July 1872 and the two names, John and then Joseph; the diaconate in 1877 and the priesthood from Bishop Vladimir of Kaluga in October 1884; the elder Ambrose choosing him as successor; the gift of foresight; his rule about obediences and his eight counsels to a nun on bearing a brother's sins; his teaching of the Jesus prayer aloud before the prayer of the mind; the daily alms at his cell; the last Liturgy at the Dormition of 1905 and the six years of illness after it; and his death holding a small white wooden cross with the relic of the Great Martyr Barbara laid on his breast. **`ambrose-of-optina` is joined to him by the page's own account** and gets a `related` row. No hymn on the page. `types` are not changed, though the page has him ordained deacon and priest: `hieromonk` is a rank the corpus holds and adding it here would rest on the Greek alone, which is a reading for a report and not a silent change.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε στις 2 Νοεμβρίου 1837 μ.Χ. στο χωριό Γκοροντίστσα της περιοχής Στάρομπελσκ της επαρχίας Καρκώφ», and the head line of the same page gives «(1837 - 1911)».

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Θεός όμως παρέτεινε την ζωή του Οσίου, που ήταν πολύτιμη για όλους, μέχρι το 1911 μ.Χ.», and the head line of the same page gives «(1837 - 1911)». The page gives no day of the month for his repose.
